data.body: [P2] Supply the required design note for this new feature. Rule 3, “Write a design note before the code,” applies to the new closed-issue notification behavior. The description identifies the shared workflow and pin, but omits the cause, alternatives including simplification of existing notification logic, selection rationale, and what the change removes. This leaves the approach unevaluated under the repository’s rules. Return to the design phase under Rule 8, step 6, and document the required design before proceeding.
